page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.7xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard general-purpose ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance contains no integrated hardware accelerators or GPUs, directing all compute capacity toward the physical x86 host processors.

Storage is entirely external, as the instance features no bundled local disk storage. Operating systems, application environments, and persistent data layers must rely on network-attached block storage volumes. In addition, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default, requiring network routing via external elastic IP resources or virtual private cloud gateways.

With a balanced compute-to-memory allocation, ecs.n2.7xlarge is structured for horizontal enterprise software stacks, multi-threaded backend services, enterprise application tiers, staging clusters, and mid-scale relational or non-relational database engines requiring moderate memory caching capacity without local drive persistence.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.7xlarge is an x86_64 instance configuration delivered via the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128.0 GB of system RAM, resulting in a balanced 1:4 processor-to-memory distribution of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local drive storage, requiring external network-attached volumes for operating systems and data retention. Furthermore, public IPv4 addresses are not included by default and must be provisioned separately. Designed without specialized vector or matrix hardware acceleration flags, the instance offers a standard general-purpose resource profile. The configuration provides dedicated compute cores and proportional memory capacity, making it technically suitable for container clusters, enterprise web applications, middle-tier business logic, batch processing, and non-disk-intensive relational databases.
